text: Cerveja Coral is a brand of Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira (ECM), the Madeira brewery, which produces, sells and distributes it, and which says it is part of the Pestana Group universe.
short: Cerveja Coral is a brand of the Madeira brewery ECM, which says it is part of the Pestana Group.

source.name: Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira: Atividade
source.quote: Fazendo parte do universo do Grupo Pestana, maior grupo hoteleiro português já com forte investimento internacional
source.note: Translation: 'Being part of the universe of the Pestana Group, the largest Portuguese hotel group with strong international investment.' The page also says ECM makes, sells and distributes its own beer, soft-drink and water brands; Coral is its flagship beer brand.

additionalSources.name: DNOTICIAS.PT: Parceria entre ECM e Nacional renovada até 2026
additionalSources.quote: A ECM que produz, vende e distribui as marcas Coral e Brisa, tem uma ligação ao CDN há mais de 30 anos
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'ECM, which produces, sells and distributes the Coral and Brisa brands, has been linked to CD Nacional for more than 30 years.' The article says ECM renewed its CD Nacional sponsorship for three more years with shirt advertising.
